items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the two-part lemma at source lines 1020-1040, label lemma-cycle-push-sheaf, whose proof (source lines 1042-1119) is a two-stage reduction: the second part is first reduced to a closed immersion through the support decomposition of a coherent sheaf and the scheme theoretic image square of the restriction of f to the support, with the equalities pushed through the diagram f_* i_* = i'_* (f|_Z)_*, and then, after the closed immersion case, to the situation where the delta-dimension of X is at most k and f is proper and surjective, where the solver must show that the components occurring in either cycle class are exactly the components of Y of delta-dimension k and that their generic points lift, before shrinking to a finite morphism over an affine open and quoting the scheme case. The counted statement records neither the diagram nor the component comparison, and several steps are controlled by prerequisites that are delivered as navigation pointers.
